niche_preference_profile: This user most often prefers interfaces that feel clear, structured, and visually breathable: light or softly contrasted surfaces, dark readable text, generous spacing, strong hierarchy, rounded card-based components, cohesive purple-leaning accents, and obvious primary actions. They repeatedly favor layouts with clear grouping, complete visible content, and refined filled surfaces over cramped, fragmented, overly dark, low-contrast, or cluttered presentations. In some task-specific cases they also like richer information when it is well organized, but overall they prefer simplicity, legibility, and polished card-based structure over decorative intensity.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers strong, obvious hierarchy with prominent titles or key summaries, clear sectioning, and well-grouped content so the main action or information stands out immediately.
Prefers open spacing, breathing room, and fewer competing elements at once; dislikes cramped, dense, fragmented, or overly busy compositions.
Usually prefers light, airy, or softly contrasted palettes with readable dark text, and tends to reject very dark, heavy, or low-contrast screens.
Prefers modular cards, filled panels, subtle depth, and clearly framed sections rather than flat, outline-heavy, or weakly separated layouts.
Prefers high-contrast text, straightforward typography, and content that is easy to scan and read without dim text or overly stylized presentation.
Prefers consistent accent usage—especially purple or soft coordinated accents—with a polished, unified visual system rather than mixed or harsher accent treatments.
Prefers obvious, well-emphasized calls to action and controls, such as full-width or clearly separated buttons, with action placement and emphasis that feels unambiguous.
